name: second-brain
description: Retires second-brain v1 and carries the internal, tested source foundation for Git-native v2 Units 01 and 02. V2 is not installable or shipped.

interface.shortDescription: Retire v1 while v2 is built.
interface.longDescription: Retires the legacy Neon/MCP second-brain v1 system. Units 01 and 02 provide an internal tested Git-native foundation, but v2 has no supported installer and is not shipped.
